scoring.distance: L2 (NOT squared: squared saturates the eq.7 exp)
scoring.map: pre-blur 28x28 min-distances, then bilinear to 224, gaussian sigma 4

tolerance: goldens are float64. bank ships fp16 (~1e-3 relative), accumulate in fp32. expect distance error ~ sqrt(1536) * fp16 eps * scale. derive the bound, do not tune it until it passes.
warning: resnet50 and wide_resnet50_2 banks are shape identical. never mix artifacts across backbones. loaders must check weights_sha256.
